name: Kitiari
source:
Department of Nursing; Desert fox + ? (Mystical Therio)

An undergrad whose hobby is treating and caring for others. Still, she gives off a dangerous vibe.

An undergrad who wishes to examine and treat people purely from a philanthropic standpoint. Yet, she also collects 'samples' as part of her hobby.
